name: bioergotech-regione-puglia
description: Builds the three documents for Regione Puglia from the self-contained HTML sources.

scripts.build: node build-pdf.mjs regione-1-fondazione.html && node build-pdf.mjs regione-2-progetto.html && node build-pdf.mjs regione-3-costi.html
scripts.check: node check.mjs regione-1-fondazione.html && node check.mjs regione-2-progetto.html && node check.mjs regione-3-costi.html
scripts.proof: node build-pdf.mjs regione-1-fondazione.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs regione-2-progetto.html --shots && node build-pdf.mjs regione-3-costi.html --shots
